In [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] bombed the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[K'avor]] on [[Shiva IV]]. In the aftermath of the '''Destruction of K'avor''', [[Aron Peacebringer]] and [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] witnessed the burning city before turning back as Organa recognized the [[Cherenkov effect]] there.
